description: This file defines the ProjectActivityAPI class which provides CRUD operations for project activities within the OrangeHRM Time module. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting project activities, along with associated validation rules and Swagger documentation annotations.

classes.name: ProjectActivityAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for managing project activities, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting activities, with Swagger annotations for documentation.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list project activities with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new project activity.

methods.name: setParamsToProjectActivity
methods.description: Assigns request parameters to a ProjectActivity entity.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing project activities.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove multiple project activities.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete request body and parameters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific project activity by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for fetching a single project activity.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a specific project activity identified by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a project activity.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Common validation rules for create and update request bodies.

methods.name: getProjectActivityCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Constructs validation options for ensuring activity name uniqueness within a project.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves projectId and activityId from URL attributes.
